s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial swelling and sinus pressure with nasal septum deviation and proptosis
salient_findings: Heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with solid and cystic components
key_facts: Several months of sinus pressure and facial swelling
Several weeks of external deviation of her nasal septum
No significant past medical history
Left nasal mass noted on examination
Mild left-sided proptosis present
CT scan showed a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus
Mass eroded the orbital floor, medial and posterior maxillary walls, and anterior ethmoid air cells
Displacement of inferior rectus without muscle invasion
Left maxillary alveolar ridge and several molar roots involved
Bony changes showed remodeling and thinning
Biopsy showed spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells
Rare mitotic activity
No cytologic atypia

shortlist.label: Giant cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Biopsy showed spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells

shortlist.label: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Mass in the maxillary sinus with erosion of surrounding structures

shortlist.label: Fibrous dysplasia
shortlist.why_kept: Bony changes showed remodeling and thinning

shortlist.label: Aneurysmal bone cyst
shortlist.why_kept: CT scan showed a heterogeneous mass with solid and cystic components

shortlist.label: Cherubism
shortlist.why_kept: Facial swelling and sinus pressure with nasal septum deviation

raw.rationale: The biopsy results showing a spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells and rare mitotic activity, along with the imaging findings of a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus, are most consistent with a giant cell tumor.

rejected.label: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
rejected.why: Typically occurs in adolescent males and is highly vascular, which is not mentioned in the case

rejected.label: Fibrous dysplasia
rejected.why: Usually presents with ground-glass appearance on imaging and does not typically show significant multinucleated giant cells on biopsy

rejected.label: Aneurysmal bone cyst
rejected.why: Typically shows fluid-fluid levels on imaging and has a different histological appearance than the described spindle cell process with giant cells

rejected.label: Cherubism
rejected.why: Usually presents with bilateral involvement of the jaw and has a distinct familial component, which is not mentioned in the case
